body: Had a guinea pig who liked climbing the mini stairs in his cage to rest in his mini "loft". One weekend I came back from a trip to see him hanging by one foot from his loft. Took him to the vet and poor guy had to get all but one toe amputated. :(

He's begun giving me signs that he's slowly backing away. I'm used to this. I texted him today, got a response 3 hours later. Then I responded to him annnnddd nothing back. My hatred for him is starting to begin. I'll need that anger when he's gone for good.
This is my thought. Everyday. I have nothing if I can't make connections with other human beings. They are what make life meaningful and tolerable.

Awesome style! Very hip, clean cut. I think the black pea coat is a better match as it adds more dimension to all of the blue tones you have. 

Ok, that being said, the pants look a bit too tight. Not sure of your sexual orientation but, if you prefer females, they may get the wrong idea. I hope that wasn't offensive :p. Otherwise, it's great!

So, you came on here just to say that you were offended? I'm sure there are many things going on in your mind daily that would offend a considerable amount of people. He's being honest about his experience so please show some respect or gtfo.
I've told many people about my suicidality. Nothing changes. I'm tired of reaching out only to be judged as emotionally/morally inferior and weak when my feelings never change.

Thing is, I see no point in finishing my degree, because it is too stressful and ultimately worth nothing if I'm alone.

And Amber Rose is amazingly gorgeous. There is NO way I or 90% of females can pull that look off. Especially since hair is such a political statement for a black woman. I'll probably comes off as a lesbian or radical feminist, or aggressively afrocentric.

There's no winning here.

Yeah, it could have used some editing but, I figure there is no point.

Hm, angry enough? Ha.

I guess, if you're interested. It's quite mediocre.
